title: Boom Logistics Ltd - acquisitions of the James Group, Camilleri Industries Australia and Sherrin Hire

timeline.event: ACCC commences review under the Merger Review Process Guidelines.
Closing date for submissions from interested parties.
ACCC decided not to oppose the acquisitions

body_sections.Summary: Boom Logistics Ltd - acquisitions of the James Group, Camilleri Industries Australia and Sherrin Hire. Boom Logistics Ltd provides lifting solutions to companies including the provision of crane-hire services. James Group, Camilleri Industries Australia and Sherrin Hire provided crane-hire services prior to the acquisitions. James Group also had an exclusive distributorship arrangement with Tadano cranes, which has also been acquired by Boom Logistics Ltd.
body_sections.Market definition: The ACCC considered the following markets in its review of Boom Logistics Ltd's acquisitions: - Regional markets for wet and dry hire of franna and other small cranes; - Regional markets for wet and dry hire of associated lifting equipment; - A national market for the wet and dry hire of crawler and pin jib cranes; - A national market for the wet and dry hire of tower cranes; - A state-wide market for wet and dry hire of rough terrain cranes; - A state-wide market for wet and dry hire of all terrain and hydraulic cranes; and - A national market for the sale and distribution of cranes.
body_sections.Competition analysis: The ACCC considers that Boom Logistics Ltd faces sufficient competitive constraints post-acquisitions and that the acquisitions are unlikely to have caused a substantial lessening of competition in any of the relevant markets. This conclusion is informed by the following factors: -  There are substitutes available to customers in the supply of cranes; - There are other crane-hire competitors available in each relevant crane-hire market; and - Customers of wet and dry hire of rough terrain, all terrain and hydraulic cranes have some countervailing power.
